The '''''Mas Ramdar''''' was a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] in [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Part of [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]], the ''Mas Ramdar'' served during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], destroying or disabling many [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] during the seven day [[Realspace/Legends|space]] engagement over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the final day of the battle, Strike Group Five clashed with the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], which was holding the captured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on board. The ''Mas Ramdar'' and the rest of the Strike Group Five prevented the ''Invisible Hand'' from escaping the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], allowing a pair of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to infiltrate the ''Invisible Hand'' and rescue Palpatine. However, the ''Mas Ramdar'' was seriously damaged by the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} [[Heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|heavy turbolaser turrets]] during the fight, forcing the dreadnaught to retreat during the battle.

==Description==
Manufactured by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]],<ref name="Dreadnaught" /> the ''Mas Ramdar'' was a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] in [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Sith" /> At 600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the ''Mas Ramdar'' was armed with twenty [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolaser cannons]], ten [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, and ten turbolaser [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]].<ref name="Dreadnaught" />

==History==
The ''Mas Ramdar'' was part of [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Strike Group Five]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Home Fleet]], which was tasked with the defense of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Like the rest of the Home [[Fleet/Legends|Fleets]]' Strike Groups, Strike Group Five&mdash;made up of the ''Mas Ramdar'' and three [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]] [[Integrity (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Integrity'']], [[Indomitable (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Indomitable'']], and ''[[Perseverance/Legends|Perseverance]]''&mdash;was hastily assembled during the Clone Wars to protect against a Separatist attack.

That attack did come when the Confederacy [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invaded]] Coruscant in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The Strike Group Five and the rest of the Home Fleet [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the Separatist [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]&mdash;lead by [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Coruscant. During the seven [[Galactic Standard Calendar|day]] battle, the ''Mas Ramdar'' destroyed or disabled many Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warships]].

However, General Grievous managed to capture Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the fighting raging on Coruscant's surface. With Palpatine being held aboard Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]&mdash;the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]&mdash;the Confederacy sounded a retreat on the final day of the battle and attempted to escape Coruscant with their captive.
